caseStudy.title: A restaurant experience guests can feel—and use.
caseStudy.text: ← All workBuilt concept demo · fictionalHospitality website · strategy, design & buildA restaurant experience guests can feel—and use.Cyvexly designed and built Velora to show how a hospitality brand can pair cinematic storytelling with clear paths to the menu, reservations, private events, and gifting.Velora is a fictional restaurant concept; the interactive experience is real, while its restaurant details and transactions are demonstrations.Open the interactive website See what was builtVelora · live conceptComplete responsive presentationGuest journeys, fully consideredCapability you can see in the experience.Velora is more than a polished landing page. The working demo connects the moments a restaurant guest expects, including the states that usually get left behind in a visual mockup.Explore every journey 01Seasonal menu discoveryEditorial dish stories become a menu guests can scan, filter, and explore without losing the sense of occasion.Menu tabs + dish details02Reservation journeyA complete date, time, party-size, and guest-details flow demonstrates validation, correction, and confirmation states.Guided form + confirmation03Private dining inquiryRoom selection and event details give special-occasion guests a focused path from inspiration to a prepared inquiry.Room choice + event brief04Gifting experienceGift-card choices, recipient details, and a clear demo checkout boundary show how commerce can feel native to the brand.Gift flow + safe demo state05Responsive navigationDesktop and mobile navigation preserve direct routes to the menu, story, private dining, visit details, and reservation action.Desktop + phone patterns06Accessible interactionNative dialogs, keyboard tabs, visible focus, reduced-motion support, and Escape return behavior are part of the experience.Keyboard + 320px reflowDesigned across the whole journeyOne atmosphere. Every screen size.The desktop composition gives the brand room to breathe. The mobile experience protects that same hierarchy while keeping the reservation and menu paths close at hand.Desktop experience · 1440pxOpen live Velora · live conceptMobile experience · 390pxBrand atmosphereEditorial, but never ornamentalCormorant Garamond carries the dining voice while Manrope keeps navigation, forms, and practical details crisp. Forest, warm paper, antique gold, and muted wine create a distinct evening mood without obscuring utility.Guest confidenceThe next action stays obviousMenu discovery, reservation, private dining, gifting, and visit details each have a clear path. Validation and correction states explain what guests need without breaking the visual rhythm.Inclusive craftPolish continues through the edge casesSemantic landmarks, a skip link, visible keyboard focus, native dialogs, reduced-motion support, and tested small-screen reflow make the demonstration usable beyond its strongest screenshot.Concept disclosureThe work is real. The restaurant is not.Velora is a Cyvexly-built fictional capability demonstration, not a client engagement or an operating restaurant. Its name, address, phone, email, menus, chef, rooms, availability, policies, and offers are sample content.Reservation, private-event, newsletter, gifting, message, purchase, and payment moments run as local demonstration flows. They validate and confirm the experience without placing a real booking, sending a message, charging a card, or transmitting personal data to a restaurant service.Your guest journey, made unmistakableWhat should your website help guests do next?Tell us about your restaurant, venue, or hospitality concept—and the reservations, inquiries, events, or customer journey it needs to support.
